name: The Stewpot Food Pantry
hoursNotes: Appointment-only within posted hours. Walk-ins accepted daily 12–1pm (same-day service not guaranteed) and on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of each month; new clients walk in once to register.
requirements: New clients register in person during walk-in hours; at least 14 days between pantry visits.
affiliation: Presbyterian (ministry of First Presbyterian Church of Dallas)
notes: Continuation of the former CitySquare food pantry at the Opportunity Center, taken over by The Stewpot in 2024.
